summary: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters warns that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, threatening to block oil exports if US attacks occur. Iran vows to target US infrastructure and allies in response to threats. US military operations against Iranian sites continue, including strikes on Bushehr Airport and Kurdistan regions.
key_points: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya warns Strait of Hormuz remains closed, requiring vessels to use designated routes (Source: @presstv/199925)
Iran threatens to target US oil/gas infrastructure if attacks proceed (Source: @presstv/199925)
US military strikes Bushehr Airport's military section (Source: @shin_persian/8378)
Iranian state media reports US strikes on Kurdistan's Baneh (Source: @VahidOnline/77392)
Iranian official Abbas Araghchi condemns US threats as violations of international law (Source: @VahidOnline/77395)
New temporary flight routes established between Baghdad and Tehran FIRs (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5548)
Iranian military warns alternative routes through Hormuz are unsafe (Source: @naya_foriraq/84915)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's explicit threats to target US oil/gas infrastructure and regional power stations indicate a high likelihood of escalation if US military actions continue. The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and threats to alternative routes suggest Iran is preparing for sustained maritime and energy sector disruptions. US strikes on Bushehr Airport and Kurdistan regions demonstrate ongoing operational targeting of Iranian military assets.
sections.regional_response: Iran's threats to target US infrastructure and allies suggest a coordinated regional response to US military actions. The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and warnings about alternative routes indicate Iran is preparing for sustained maritime and energy sector disruptions. US strikes on Bushehr Airport and Kurdistan regions demonstrate ongoing operational targeting of Iranian military assets.
sections.intelligence_notes: The US military's continued strikes on Iranian sites, including Bushehr Airport and Kurdistan regions, suggest a sustained operational campaign against Iranian military infrastructure. Iran's explicit threats to target US oil/gas infrastructure and regional power stations indicate a high likelihood of escalation if US military actions continue. The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and warnings about alternative routes suggest Iran is preparing for sustained maritime and energy sector disruptions.
